name: B2Gold Corp.
summary: B2Gold Corp. operates as a gold producer company in Canada. The company operates the Fekola Mine in Mali; the Masbate Mine in the Philippines; the Otjikoto Mine in Namibia; the Goose Mine in Canada. It also owns 100% interest in the Gramalote gold project in Colombia. In addition, the company has a portfolio of other evaluation and exploration assets in Mali, Canada and Finland. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
